correctness.rationale: Rows are constant exactly on compatibility components. This yields 2^(n c(Q)) unrestricted modal relations for fixed Q. For equivalence M the condition is Q subset M; counting edges within its partition blocks gives the second exact sum and recurrence. A spanning-forest overcount bounds unrestricted nonidentity Q weights by (1+2^(-n/2))^(n(n-1)/2)-1 ->0. Splitting partitions by the existence of a block greater than n/2 bounds all nonuniversal M relative weights by a vanishing geometric sum plus n^n 2^(-n^2/4). Conditional M universal, Q is G(n,1/2), which is connected with high probability by a cut union bound. Direct independent finite enumeration corroborates counts but does not prove limits.
